Module io.github.jpersist.tools.api
Package persistence.tools

Interface EntityModelLinter

All Superinterfaces:
PersistenceLinter
public interface EntityModelLinter extends PersistenceLinter
Contract for statically inspecting a JPA entity metamodel to detect mapping, structural, and performance anti-patterns at build time.

Implementations analyze compiled entity class bytecode and reflection metadata to report potential design and performance issues without requiring a live database connection or application deployment. Typical checks include:

  • Structural checks: Missing default no-arg constructors, final entity classes or methods, non-getter/setter method signatures, and missing identifier definitions.
  • Relationship mapping checks: Eager fetching on associations (e.g., @OneToMany, @ManyToMany, @ManyToOne, or @OneToOne), missing mappedBy attributes on bidirectional relationships, and unordered @ManyToMany list collections.

Usage Example


 EntityModelLinterFactory factory = EntityModelLinterFactory.newEntityModelLinterFactory("3.1");
 EntityModelLinter linter = factory.newEntityModelLinter(
     List.of("com.example.model.Order", "com.example.model.OrderItem")
 );

 List<LintDiagnostic> diagnostics = linter.lint();
 for (LintDiagnostic diagnostic : diagnostics) {
     if (diagnostic.severity() == LintSeverity.ERROR) {
         System.err.println(diagnostic.ruleId() + " [" + diagnostic.className() + "]: " + diagnostic.message());
     }
 }
